title: Pure Crusadia
summary: Pure Crusadia Link-climbing OTK and control build with generic hand traps, staples, and an automatic Extra Deck. Every Main Deck Crusadia monster can Special Summon itself from the hand in Defense Position to a zone a Link Monster points to, triggering the Crusadia Links to search the next step of the climb and adding its original ATK to the Link Monster.

summary.title: Starters
points: Any two Main Deck Crusadia monsters (Crusadia Maximus, Reclusia, Draco, Arboria, or Leonis) start the full Link climb: the first Normal Summons into Crusadia Magius, and the second Special Summons itself to Magius's downward arrow.
Crusadia Magius (Link-1) searches any Crusadia monster from the Deck when an Effect Monster is Special Summoned to the zone it points to.
Crusadia Draco adds a Crusadia monster with a different name from your GY to your hand when Normal or Special Summoned to a Link-pointed zone, extending the climb off a third body.

summary.title: Opening: Any 2 Crusadia Monsters
steps: Normal Summon any Crusadia monster and Link Summon Crusadia Magius in the Extra Monster Zone.
Special Summon your second Crusadia monster to the zone Magius points to; Magius triggers to search Crusadia Draco from the Deck.

Link Summon Crusadia Regulex using Magius and your second Crusadia, then Special Summon Crusadia Draco to Regulex's arrow: Draco recovers the first Crusadia from the GY and Regulex searches a Crusadia Spell or Trap (such as Crusadia Revival, Power, or Vanguard).
Link Summon Crusadia Equimax (or climb into Mekk-Knight Crusadia Avramax) and Special Summon Crusadia Maximus to Equimax's arrow.

summary.title: OTK & Bosses
points: Crusadia Equimax (Link-3) gains the combined original ATK of all monsters it points to and Tributes a Crusadia or World Legacy monster it points to as a Quick Effect to negate a face-up card's effects until the End Phase.
Crusadia Maximus doubles any battle damage a Crusadia Link Monster inflicts in battle with an opponent's monster for the turn, while Crusadia Leonis grants piercing battle damage.

Mekk-Knight Crusadia Avramax (Link-4) cannot be targeted by opponent's card effects, forces all attacks onto itself, gains a Special Summoned monster's ATK during battle, and shuffles a card into the Deck if sent to the GY.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Crusadia Revival boosts all Crusadia Link Monsters by 500 ATK and lets one Crusadia Link Monster attack all monsters the opponent controls once each.

Crusadia Power makes a Crusadia monster unaffected by other card effects for the turn, and Crusadia Testament prevents the opponent from responding to your Crusadia monster effect activations (or draws cards equal to your Crusadia Link's Rating after destroying a monster by battle).

Crusadia Vanguard Tributes a Crusadia or World Legacy monster to Special Summon a differently named one from the Deck or GY, while Crusadia Arboria banishes itself from the GY to prevent a Crusadia from being destroyed.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Crusadia Krawler is omitted from the pure build because its on-summon search fetches World Legacy cards rather than Crusadia cards.
